query: INSERT INTO charge_master (tenant_id, code, name, category, base_price, tax_percent, hsn_sac_code, gst_category) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, code) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, category = EXCLUDED.category, base_price = EXCLUDED.base_price, tax_percent = EXCLUDED.tax_percent, hsn_sac_code = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.hsn_sac_code, charge_master.hsn_sac_code), gst_category = EXCLUDED.gst_category, is_active = true, updated_at = now()
